verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers OCI's CLI, SDKs, Terraform provider, IAM, billing, and free tier offerings, but nothing describes a dedicated sandbox/staging environment isolated from production data for testing (e.g., a test tenancy, dry-run mode, or agent test harness). The Free Tier/Trial credits (oracle-cloud-docs-10/11/12) are about cost, not an isolated sandbox for agentic testing, and community evidence even highlights risk to production resources (oracle-cloud-comm-11) rather than confirming isolation. missing for 10: no documented sandbox/staging tenancy or dry-run testing mode for AI-native/agentic workflows, no evidence of production-data isolation guarantees.
